scoring_justification: Recomputation from raw DFT artifacts is not feasible in the lightweight verifier; compare reported energies to paper's published values with ±5 kJ/mol tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold relative energies from paper Table S1/Figure 10: SA 27.3, SB 21.9, SC 14.0, SD 13.7 kJ/mol per Si atom
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Chemistry of Materials 2014, Table S1 and Figure 10
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported numbers; they match the reference solve.sh oracle which writes them

outputs.description: Relative total energies of the four S-type Si allotropes (SA, SB, SC, SD) with respect to diamond-cubic α-Si, computed at PBE0/SVP level. The checker compares each energy to a hidden gold value and verifies that SD is the most stable.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker performs an exact-match comparison against the published values with a tolerance that absorbs toolchain spread. It also checks the relative ordering to ensure SD has the lowest energy. The agent must therefore produce physically reasonable energies from the DFT workflow.

steps.description: Verify SA energy within ±5 kJ/mol of paper value 27.3 kJ/mol per Si.
Verify SB energy within ±5 kJ/mol of 21.9 kJ/mol per Si.
Verify SC energy within ±5 kJ/mol of 14.0 kJ/mol per Si.
Verify SD energy within ±5 kJ/mol of 13.7 kJ/mol per Si.
Verify SD has the lowest energy among the four allotropes.
